The population density of Greenland, in people per square kilometer of land area, increased from $0.022$ in $1995$ to $0.026$ in $2020$. During this time period, the land area of Greenland was $2, 100, 000$ square kilometers.

By how many people did Greenland's population increase from $1995$ to $2020$?

:knowledge-point/title: Finding a Difference Given Two Rates
